market_intro: Extensions from the marketplaces this hub has added. See what each one can do before you agree to install it. Packages are checked against the marketplace's sha256.
no_markets_body: A marketplace is an index of extensions (persona-extensions.json) published by a website or GitHub repo. Add one to browse and install its extensions here.
market_empty: This marketplace has no extensions yet
markets_read_empty: No extensions in the markets that could be read yet
gone: This extension is no longer in this marketplace
can_footer: These are listed again before installing, and nothing is installed until you agree. If a later version asks for more, you'll be asked again before it updates.
no_permissions: It's just a manifest. It runs no program and needs no permissions.
more_permissions: The new version asks for more permissions than you agreed to before. Check what's new before deciding. If you don't agree, it won't update and the current version keeps working.
bundle_footer: Once you agree, these extensions are installed in order, and your consent covers each one's permissions. Members already installed at a suitable version are skipped.
bundle_no_permissions: Runs no program, needs no permissions.
unresolved: Can't install yet: {items}. Resolve these and preview again.
preview_expired: This preview has expired. Close it and select Install again.
preview_valid_one: This preview is valid for 1 minute. Installing checks it again: it only installs if the permissions match what you see.
preview_valid_other: This preview is valid for {count} minutes. Installing checks it again: it only installs if the permissions match what you see.
uninstalled_warnings: Uninstall completed. Follow the instructions below.
uninstall_body: Stops its program and deletes its package, config, and secrets, along with the connectors and other things it provides. To use it again, reinstall it from the marketplace.
keep_data_hint: Pick up where you left off if you reinstall.
disable_dependents: Also disable the extensions that depend on it: {names} (not uninstalled)
market_removed: Removed "{name}". Extensions installed from it stay but no longer upgrade
remove_market_note: The hub stops reading this market. Extensions installed from it stay, but stop upgrading until the market is added again with the same address.
remove_market_affected_one: The hub stops reading this market. 1 extension installed from it stays, but stops upgrading until the market is added again with the same address.
remove_market_affected_other: The hub stops reading this market. {count} extensions installed from it stay, but stop upgrading until the market is added again with the same address.
remove_market_unused: The hub stops reading this market. No installed extension came from it.
markets_intro: The hub reads these marketplaces' indexes (persona-extensions.json). A GitHub marketplace can take a read-only token: private repos need one to be read, and public repos get a higher rate limit so they're less likely to be throttled. The token is stored encrypted on the hub, sent only to that marketplace, and never shown again. git: marketplaces use the hub machine's own SSH credentials.
auto_footer_on: When an extension from these marketplaces has a new version, the hub installs it while the extension is idle, and asks you first if it needs more permissions. You can turn this off for each extension on its own page.
auto_footer_off: Off: new versions are only flagged on the extension's page, and you update them yourself.
markets_empty: No marketplaces yet. Select Add marketplace at the top right and enter an https URL, github:owner/repo, or git:….
token_rate_limit_hint: Without a token, GitHub allows only 60 reads an hour, shared by every device on the same network. Adding a GitHub token raises that to 5,000, including for public repositories (for a fine-grained token, choose Public repositories and leave every permission unchecked).
token_placeholder_git: git: marketplaces don't use a token
token_placeholder: Required for private repos, optional for public ones
token_hint_git: git: marketplaces are read with the hub machine's own SSH credentials and take no token.
token_hint: For GitHub, use a read-only fine-grained token: for a private repo, give it Contents read access; for a public repo, choose Public repositories with no permissions, which raises the limit from 60 reads an hour to 5,000. It's stored encrypted on the hub and never shown again.
adding: Reading its index. It's added once that works…
token_input_replace: Enter a new token to replace it
token_reload_note: After saving, the hub reads the index again with it.
op_gone: It's no longer running: its assistant doesn't have it any more (it may have restarted). You can start it again.
official_unreachable: Can't reach the official extensions right now. Try again later.
official_token_link: Rate-limited? Add a GitHub token in Manage marketplaces
market_unread: Extensions show up here once the market can be read.
token_create_hint: No token yet? Create one on GitHub: the name, purpose and a one-year expiry are filled in and no permissions are needed. Click Generate token, then paste it above.
for_manager: For the assistant “{name}”: only its copy changes (each assistant has its own extensions).
